title: Distribution and link-check code still builds URLs on the dead /monorepo-projects/ Pages path
problem: About 100 files outside research/ventures/docs hard-code https://duncan-haywood.github.io/monorepo-projects/ as the site base (platform/distribution/bluesky.mjs, devto.mjs, hub/compose.mjs, mcp.mjs, citation.mjs, agents/tools.mjs, daily/build.mjs, ci/venture_live_links.py and more). That path returns 404; the catalogue is served at /oss-monorepo/. Posts, feeds and live-link checks built from these constants point at dead pages or check the wrong host.
evidence: CLAUDE.md 'Hosting' names /oss-monorepo/ as the served URL
change: Introduce one shared base-URL constant (env PAGES_BASE_URL with the /oss-monorepo/ default) used by the JS and Python modules, update tests that assert the old string, and add a platform/ci lint that fails on the dead path outside historical notes. Confirm first whether any of these are deliberate legacy redirects.
metric: count of files under platform/ containing the dead base URL
